t: That this Act may be cited as the “Justice System Improvement Act of 1979”.

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision naming the Act the "Justice System Improvement Act of 1979". There is no tempting reading here: it sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is involved in any federal decision.
